effect.command: source .venv/bin/activate && git ls-files -- test/registered/unit/sampling test/registered/unit/model_executor > /tmp/ml-effect.txt && cd test && python3 run_suite.py --hw cpu --suite base-a-test-cpu --only-file-list /tmp/ml-effect.txt --timeout-per-file 300

performance.command: source .venv/bin/activate && git ls-files -- 'test/registered/unit/mem_cache/*radix*' > /tmp/ml-perf.txt && cd test && python3 run_suite.py --hw cpu --suite base-a-test-cpu --only-file-list /tmp/ml-perf.txt --timeout-per-file 300

stability.command: source .venv/bin/activate && git ls-files -- test/registered/unit/spec > /tmp/ml-stab.txt && cd test && python3 run_suite.py --hw cpu --suite base-a-test-cpu --only-file-list /tmp/ml-stab.txt --timeout-per-file 300

usability.command: source .venv/bin/activate && git ls-files -- test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai test/registered/unit/parser test/registered/unit/function_call | grep -vE 'test_serving_decisions|test_template_manager|test_function_call_parser' > /tmp/ml-use.txt && cd test && python3 run_suite.py --hw cpu --suite base-a-test-cpu --only-file-list /tmp/ml-use.txt --timeout-per-file 300
